Outcome_variable.evidence_source: Different aspects for measuring life satisfaction are presented in Table 1 and included one specific item on global life satisfaction/quality of life... Global life satisfaction at pregnancy weeks 15–19 and six months postpartum was evaluated by the 5-item Satisfaction With Life Scale... Instead of the Satisfaction With Life Scale, we used an available screening question on quality of life from the World Health Organization's Quality of Life Instrument — Short Version to assess global life satisfaction 18 months postpartum.
Outcome_variable.warning: Other well-being related constructs (self-esteem, relationship satisfaction, work strain, general self-efficacy) were measured but are not among the target Outcome_variables (life satisfaction, positive affect, negative affect). Emotional distress was mentioned but only as a predictor, not an outcome for which descriptive statistics were reported.
